version.changelog: v1.4.11 能力层收窄：构建期裁剪 CLI + 运行期白名单闸 + export 落点加固

llm.summary: The skill is mostly coherent, but it needs review because its CLI can run paid ARI operations outside the advertised fixed mobile-listing workflow and its local API-key storage has a real hardening gap.

dimensions.detail: Authenticated HTTPS requests to the fixed ari.funewa.com origin, account checks, balance checks, and review collection are disclosed and broadly proportionate to the ARI-backed diagnostic workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No dependency installer, remote code loader, service registration, or package mutation was found. The skill uses Bash to run the bundled Python CLI.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact repeatedly says the skill must not switch workflows or accept arbitrary prompts, but the executable exposes generic workflow/focus parameters for server-side product operations. Quote and --confirm gates reduce risk but do not fully scope the capability.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The setup/configure flow persists an ARI API key under ~/.ari/config.json with mode 0600, but the write path follows existing symlinks and does not verify ownership or regular-file status. No background persistence or privilege escalation was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is mobile Amazon Listing diagnosis using product details and reviews, which matches most documentation and API calls; however, operations quote/run accept --workflow and --focus overrides instead of enforcing the documented listing/mobile contract.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable granting this skill an ARI API key and allowing confirmed, credit-consuming ARI operations. Before use, keep ~/.ari private, avoid shared or synced config directories, and verify that any operation shown for confirmation is specifically the listing/mobile workflow you intended.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Credential setup, account checks, balance checks, and review collection are disclosed support functions, but the generic operations workflow/focus override is broader than the fixed mobile-listing purpose.
[LP1] expected: Authenticated requests and local API-key use are expected for this ARI service integration and are documented, though the local key-write implementation has a separate hardening issue.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted in part: scripts/ari.py exposes operations quote/run/status for arbitrary workflow/focus values when supplied, despite the skill-defaults listing/mobile purpose.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Paid collection is disclosed and requires confirmation, but generic paid operations are not tightly limited to the advertised mobile-listing workflow.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese documentation and /zh links are visible localization choices, not hidden behavior or a security basis for escalation.
[EA2] unexpected: Not supported by the current artifact: the cited changelog says autoconfirm was removed, and current paid collection/analysis paths require explicit --confirm after quote.
[P9] unexpected: Reviewed the whitespace locations; they are blank-line padding between functions and do not conceal additional instructions or code.
[AST7] expected: The getattr use is limited to a fixed tuple of argparse attribute names for ASIN validation and is not dynamic code execution.
[T09] unexpected: The static finding is valid as a local hardening concern: save_key truncates an existing path without symlink or ownership checks before writing the API key.
